The issuer shows weak short-term liquidity with a current ratio of 0.83 and a highly leveraged balance sheet (total liabilities of ~1.68T vs. total assets of ~1.81T, leaving relatively low equity). However, operating profitability appears solid (EBIT of 5.855B on revenue of 30.125B, ~19% margin), which partially offsets balance-sheet pressure. Overall, credit quality seems consistent with a speculative-grade profile.

DECISION: BB-
